quotes.text: I am The Fool who does not belong to this era. I am the mysterious ruler above the fog.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: In the face of the unknown, reverence is the best protection.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: Everyone has their own lucky number. Mine is 4.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: A lady must always maintain her composure.
quotes.speaker: Audrey Hall

quotes.text: The sea remembers everything.
quotes.speaker: Alger Wilson

quotes.text: The City of Silver endures. We have survived worse.
quotes.speaker: Derrick Berg

quotes.text: I am a vampire of culture and refinement. Please remember that.
quotes.speaker: Emlyn White

quotes.text: Hmph. How could a mere human understand the elegance of my kind?
quotes.speaker: Emlyn White

quotes.text: There is poetry in the darkness, if one knows where to look.
quotes.speaker: Leonard Mitchell

quotes.text: Heh, the old fellow in my head has something to say about that.
quotes.speaker: Leonard Mitchell

quotes.text: Knowledge is the truest treasure. Every door leads somewhere.
quotes.speaker: Cattleya

quotes.text: Every door leads somewhere — you just need to know how to open it.
quotes.speaker: Cattleya

quotes.text: Justice is a matter of law, not mercy.
quotes.speaker: Xio Derecha

quotes.text: The truth always comes to light — it just needs someone to find it.
quotes.speaker: Xio Derecha

quotes.text: Words carry power — I simply write them down.
quotes.speaker: Fors Wall

quotes.text: I'm just a novelist who happens to know a little magic.
quotes.speaker: Fors Wall

quotes.text: Fear is not the absence of courage. It is the beginning of wisdom.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: The world is far more terrifying than you imagine. But also far more wonderful.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: I believe that one day, we will see the real sun again.
quotes.speaker: Derrick Berg

quotes.text: On the ocean, caution is the difference between life and death.
quotes.speaker: Alger Wilson

quotes.text: A true detective never stops asking questions — especially the uncomfortable ones.
quotes.speaker: Xio Derecha

quotes.text: The most dangerous secrets are the ones we keep from ourselves.
quotes.speaker: Audrey Hall

quotes.text: History is written by the victors. But the Historical Void remembers everything.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: Above the fog, a gathering of those who seek truth in a world of secrets.
quotes.speaker: Narrator

quotes.text: Not all who wander through the fog are lost. Some are simply searching for what others cannot see.
quotes.speaker: Narrator

quotes.text: To walk a pathway is to surrender part of yourself to something greater — and more terrible.
quotes.speaker: Narrator

quotes.text: I am merely a messenger carrying out The Fool's will.
quotes.speaker: Klein Moretti

quotes.text: The Tarot Gathering is not a place for the faint of heart.
quotes.speaker: Narrator
